requirements.text: REQ-HONEST-FLOW: honest lending, borrowing at the 95% limit, leverage by minting and repayment remain possible: the honest session runs to completion with the expected result.
REQ-ALLOWED-SUCCEEDS: every allowed operation succeeds, from any state.
REQ-EFFECTS: a successful operation produces exactly the specified next state.
REQ-ACTOR-HEALTHY: from any state, after a successful withdraw, borrow, mint, burn, transfer or donation the acting account is healthy, and after a liquidation the liquidator is healthy.
REQ-STAYS-HEALTHY: from any state, no successful operation makes a healthy account unhealthy.
REQ-NO-BAD-DEBT: in every state reachable from `genesis` by any sequence of operations, every account is healthy: no account holds more debt than its risk-adjusted collateral.

import Solution
import EulerLending.Spec

/-!
Generated by harness/counterexample.py. Refutes `EulerLending.req_actor_healthy` (REQ-ACTOR-HEALTHY) for the candidate's definitions
on the failing case

{"n": 3, "ops": [["deposit", 0, 8904507], ["deposit", 1, 20000000], ["mint", 1, 200000000], ["repay", 1, 10000000], ["mint", 1, 200000000], ["donate", 1, 100000000], ["liquidate", 2, 1, "max"], ["withdraw", 2, 38904507]]}

step 5 of the case, ['donate', 1, 100000000], from the reported state before it
-/

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 20000000

namespace EulerLending

theorem cex_req_actor_healthy : ¬ (ActorHealthy step) := by
  intro h
  have hx := h (({ acct := (fun u => [⟨8904507, 0⟩, ⟨420000000, 390000000⟩, ⟨0, 0⟩].getD u ⟨0, 0⟩), cash := 38904507, reserves := 0 } : St)) ((Op.donate 1 100000000)) _ (1) (by first | decide | exact (Option.some_get (by decide)).symm | rfl | (simp -failIfUnchanged only [Healthy, Allowed, OthersSame, OthersSame2, EffectOn, Checked, HonestFlow, AllowedSucceeds, Effects, ActorHealthy, StaysHealthy, NoBadDebt] <;> decide)) (by first | decide | exact (Option.some_get (by decide)).symm | rfl | (simp -failIfUnchanged only [Healthy, Allowed, OthersSame, OthersSame2, EffectOn, Checked, HonestFlow, AllowedSucceeds, Effects, ActorHealthy, StaysHealthy, NoBadDebt] <;> decide))
  first
    | (revert hx; decide)
    | (revert hx; decide +kernel)
    | (simp -failIfUnchanged only [Healthy, Allowed, OthersSame, OthersSame2, EffectOn, Checked, HonestFlow, AllowedSucceeds, Effects, ActorHealthy, StaysHealthy, NoBadDebt] at hx <;> (revert hx; decide))
    | (repeat (first | exact absurd hx (by decide) | exact absurd hx.1 (by decide) | replace hx := hx.2); done)

end EulerLending

import Solution
import EulerLending.Spec

/-!
Generated by harness/counterexample.py. Refutes `EulerLending.req_no_bad_debt` (REQ-NO-BAD-DEBT) for the candidate's definitions
on the failing case

{"n": 3, "ops": [["deposit", 0, 8904507], ["deposit", 1, 20000000], ["mint", 1, 200000000], ["repay", 1, 10000000], ["mint", 1, 200000000], ["donate", 1, 100000000], ["liquidate", 2, 1, "max"], ["withdraw", 2, 38904507]]}

the 6 operations that succeed up to step 5 leave account 1 unhealthy
-/

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 20000000

namespace EulerLending

theorem cex_reachable_of_run :
    ∀ (ops : List Op) (s s' : St), Reachable step s → runAll step s ops = some s' →
      Reachable step s'
  | [], s, s', h, hr => by
    simp only [runAll, Option.some.injEq] at hr
    exact hr ▸ h
  | op :: ops, s, s', h, hr => by
    simp only [runAll] at hr
    split at hr
    · rename_i s1 h1
      exact cex_reachable_of_run ops s1 s' (Reachable.step op h h1) hr
    · cases hr

theorem cex_req_no_bad_debt : ¬ (NoBadDebt step) := by
  intro h
  have := h _ (cex_reachable_of_run ([(Op.deposit 0 8904507), (Op.deposit 1 20000000), (Op.mint 1 200000000), (Op.repay 1 10000000), (Op.mint 1 200000000), (Op.donate 1 100000000)] : List Op) genesis _ Reachable.genesis
    (Option.some_get (by decide : (runAll step genesis ([(Op.deposit 0 8904507), (Op.deposit 1 20000000), (Op.mint 1 200000000), (Op.repay 1 10000000), (Op.mint 1 200000000), (Op.donate 1 100000000)] : List Op)).isSome = true)).symm) 1
  revert this
  first | decide | decide +kernel

end EulerLending
